summary: Aura Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, attaching a press release dated May 6, 2026, announcing a regular quarterly dividend declaration. The board declared a dividend of US$0.78 per common share (US$0.26 per BDR), totaling approximately US$65.4 million, based on Q1 2026 results. The dividend is derived from the company's dividend policy and is not a special capital return event. The record date is May 19, 2026, with payment on May 26, 2026 for shares and around June 5, 2026 for BDRs. No other special-situation activity is indicated.
